title: feat(spec): ApprovalRequestRow declares current_step_label, the sys_approval_request column's own name for the step label
body:
Fixes #24309

Clause-②: yes

## What this changes

`ApprovalRequestRow` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/approval-service.ts`) now declares an optional `current_step_label?: string` in its display-enrichment block, beside `step_label`. Its docblock says what it is: the declared `sys_approval_request.current_step_label` column under its own name, served so that a page bound to `sys_approval_request` can list the step by its label. Such a page names the object's declared fields, and `step_label` is not one of them, so today the request page's strip can list only `current_step`, the node's machine id.

`step_label` stays, so no reader moves.

This is the spec half of the split that triage took on the consumer card (option A). The services half serves the member from plugin-approvals' `rowFromRequest` and lists it on the strip. That half is the consumer card's own work: #24281 remains open, and this PR does not touch `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/**` or the request page.

## Files

- `packages/spec/src/contracts/approval-service.ts`: the member and its docblock.
- `packages/spec/src/contracts/approval-service.test.ts`: four pins beside the existing `acted_as` and `organization_id` pins:
  - a `{} extends Pick` alias that turns red on a required member;
  - an exact `string | undefined` alias;
  - `step_label` at the same shape;
  - a runtime read-back on a row without the member and on a row with it.
- `.changeset/24309-approval-current-step-label.md`: `minor` on `@objectstack/spec`, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`.

No generated artefact moved. After a rebuild, `check:generated` reports all 14 artefacts up to date. `api-surface/` records that the interface exists, not its members.

## Premise, re-read on `origin/main` `52ff308b8`

- `ApprovalRequestRow` is at `approval-service.ts:138`, and `step_label?: string` is at `:223`, with no `current_step_label`.
- `sys_approval_request` declares the column `current_step_label` (`sys-approval-request.object.ts:330`, a readonly `Field.text`).
- plugin-approvals' `rowFromRequest` serves the label only as `step_label` (`approval-service.ts:1183`).

## Who reads the type

- **This repo** (`git grep ApprovalRequestRow`):
  - `@objectstack/spec`: the contract and its test;
  - `@objectstack/client`;
  - `@objectstack/plugin-approvals`: the producer, `action-link-pages.ts`, and seven test files.
  
  No `keyof ApprovalRequestRow` map or exhaustive `Record` over its keys exists, so an optional member breaks no reader.
- **objectui**, read at both its pin before the merge (`5e15928b4631`) and its pin after it (`0707b4ae3712`):
  - `packages/app-shell/src/views/approval-decision/ApprovalDecisionPanel.tsx` imports the spec type, and only through a `Pick` of `payload` and `payload_display`;
  - the console inbox (`apps/console/src/services/approvalsApi.ts`) declares its own local `ApprovalRequestRow` and reads `step_label` from it.
  
  Neither is affected.

## Verification

Then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals --filter @objectstack/client typecheck`: VERDICT command-exit 0, `tsc --noEmit` plus `check:test-typecheck` OK for both. The build filter is the two consumers' dependency closure, `@objectstack/spec` included.
- Reverse verification, at `ef7bb1a93`: a probe file in plugin-approvals typed two rows as `ApprovalRequestRow`. With `current_step_label: 'Manager Review'` the row compiled clean. With `current_step_label: 42`, `tsc` printed exactly one error, TS2322 "Type 'number' is not assignable to type 'string'". A stale `.d.ts` would have answered TS2353 on both rows, so the consumer reads the rebuilt declaration. The probe was deleted, and `git status` is clean.
- Ablation, at `11acbc435`, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the anchor went from 1 hit to 0 and the blob from `e1e2e927` to `9515560b`. The member deleted, `check:test-typecheck` went red: "src/contracts/approval-service.test.ts: 7 type error(s)". Restored: the blob equals the HEAD blob `e1e2e927`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The pin is a compile-time pin: its teeth are `check:test-typecheck`, inside the spec `typecheck` that the required `TypeScript Type Check` job runs.
- Gates: `dispatch-gates --commands` (no paths) derived 86 families at `11acbc435`. All 86 ran with exit 0. `dispatch-gates --ran`: "86 derived, 86 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN".

## Acceptance notes

- **Declared ahead of its producer.** Until #24281 lands, the approvals get does not carry `current_step_label`. The member is optional, and its docblock says it is served from #24281 on. That split and its order are triage's ruling on the consumer card.
- **objectui typecheck: not run locally.** objectui resolves the published `@objectstack/spec`, not this worktree, so a local run would measure nothing about this diff. The one spec-type import is a `Pick` of two members this PR does not change. The full battery's `Console Pin Gate` builds objectui at its pin against `main`.
- **Not run locally, left to CI.** `test:repo` (the vitest `repo` project): this diff touches none of its tests. The `check:dev-prereqs` scan: its self-test is green, but its existence half needs the whole workspace built, which this card does not need. `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core` and `Lint & Repo Gates` run the full set on this PR.
- `origin/main` moved three commits after the merge (`2b7fc52c3`, `889bf122e`, `85be049d5`). None of them touches `packages/spec` or these files, so the branch was not merged again.
